answers.reason: The senate decides on university-wide statutes and strategy, which is not the research associate's specific area.
The budget planning round deals with university-wide fund allocation, outside the research associate's duties.
The appointment committee selects professors, which does not match the research associate's role.
The faculty council handles overarching faculty governance rather than the specific tasks of a research associate.
The study commission prepares changes to whole degree programmes, whereas every member only participates in one body matching their specific matters.
The examination board deals with student examination matters, which is outside the research associate's scope.
The research associate assists in research projects, making the internal research funding round for research projects the one place where their matters are decided.
Since each member only takes part in one body and the research associate's primary role centers on research projects, they do not sit in the module revision group.
Procurement of laboratory equipment is a separate matter not assigned to the research associate's primary domain.
Planning the orientation week for new students is unrelated to the research associate's duties.
